name: taxi-car-service
description: Pre-book taxi service platform — user web, user app, driver app

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:g63-apk: npm run build:shared && cd apps/mobile-driver && npx expo prebuild --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../exports/G63.apk
scripts.build:driver-apk: npm run build:shared && cd apps/mobile-driver && npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean && echo sdk.dir=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk > android/local.properties && cd android && ./gradlew clean assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../../exports/driverapp.apk
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@taxi/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
